facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim arrived at the island. Pirates started fighting! Jim was scared but brave. Jim acted bravely.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim finally reached Treasure Island. The island was covered with thick forests. The pirates started their mutiny with guns and swords! Jim was frightened, but he did not run away. Jim acted bravely. True bravery means acting even when you are afraid.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: When the Hispaniola finally anchored near Treasure Island, chaos erupted. The pirates, led by Silver, launched their mutiny with terrifying shouts. Gunshots echoed across the island as the two sides clashed violently. Jim's heart pounded with fear, but he refused to hide or run away. Jim acted bravely. However, Jim learned that bravery is not the absence of fear. Because true courage means acting despite being terrified, Jim pushed forward. His small but brave actions proved that heroes come in all sizes.
facts.Word cards: bravely = 용감하게 / afraid = 두려운 / save = 구하다 / pirates = 해적들
